name: Funes's Hoard
purpose: Gives the assistant a local memory of desktop activity and audio sessions. Records and transcribes meetings and voice notes, searches transcripts, and merges them with screen and clipboard memory in one citable timeline.
notes: Local episodic memory: foreground app/window, idle/away, files and commits. Audio recording, transcription, session management and search run inside Funes at /audio and share one launcher and one MCP connection. Audio data lives in data/audio and is retained independently of desktop-activity retention. Recall preserves the source id 'scribe' for existing citations, while Argus (screen) and Echo (clipboard) remain external sources.
